title.en: vintage market at the gran madre.

line.en: vintage market near the gran madre church on sunday 15 november. go late morning; in november a coat is worth bringing.
line.de: vintage-markt in der nähe der kirche gran madre am sonntag 15. november. am späten vormittag hingehen; im november lohnt ein mantel.
line.tr: 15 kasım pazar günü gran madre kilisesinin yanında vintage pazarı. öğleye doğru git; kasım ayında mont al.

sparks.why: Vintage market at the Gran Madre, sun 15 nov 2026, per the virgilio.it Torino events list.

title.en: daebak, korean festival at the mercato centrale.
title.de: daebak, koreanisches festival im mercato centrale.

line.en: the second daebak korean culture festival runs at the mercato centrale on saturday and sunday, 14 and 15 november. go at midday; the venue is indoors.
line.de: das zweite daebak-festival zur koreanischen kultur läuft am samstag und sonntag, 14. und 15. november, im mercato centrale. am mittag hingehen; der ort ist überdacht.
line.tr: daebak'ın ikinci kore kültürü festivali 14 ve 15 kasım cumartesi ve pazar günleri mercato centrale'de. öğlen git; mekan kapalı alanda.

sparks.why: DAEBAK korean festival, second edition, at Mercato Centrale Torino on sat 14 and sun 15 nov 2026, per the virgilio.it Torino events list.
